items.title: Mr. X Interview, 1961-03-18
items.q: First we were talking about Lula White's place and you say you never heard it called Mahogany Hall? No, not at all.

ctx.x: A few of the questions. First we were talking about Lula White's place and you say you never heard it called Mahogany Hall? No, not at all. I'm wondering too if that was made up from the song title. One of her nephews, a piano player, wrote a piece both the Basin Street Blues and called Mahogany Hall Stomp. That name is a lot of people. That doesn't register with me at all. I think that Mahogany Hall probably didn't really originate hardly here. It might have originated other places. You were talking about this…
And then I must have had a... It ran all the way through to Franklin Street.
